native_current_main_boundary.meaning: The op18 implementation is an isolated successor candidate; this source review does not advertise it on the frozen current DLL.

claims.claim: The narrow original callback has void(window*) ABI at image+17E9B60. Do not hand-build the queued command or invent queue ABI.
The original builder consumes actual global actor, window Faith, type definition, barony full ID and the complete ordered artifact vector.
The callback ignores the queue AL result and resets/closes the window on its submission branch. Reset, callback return and enqueue ACK cannot prove creation.
Execution revalidates the original command and recalculates/applies resources. The cached 10-resource UI vector is not the executed debit.
The created site carries a full ID, exact type and location, then receives the Faith association.

Existing player HolySite snapshots can supply independent after observations, but each matched Site.available and FaithRelation.available/faith_lists_site must be checked; outer.available alone is insufficient.
